hooks.command: if command -v plumbcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec plumbcheck hook post-edit; else echo '{"systemMessage": "plumbcheck is not on PATH; its post-edit hook is skipped"}'; fi
if command -v plumbcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec plumbcheck hook stop; else echo '{"systemMessage": "plumbcheck is not on PATH; its stop hook is skipped"}'; fi
